metadata.title: A planar program for the two-variable Jacobian conjecture: a theorem ladder, staircase transport, and machine certificates at the (72,108) frontier
metadata.description:
Paper B of a three-paper research record. The two-variable Jacobian conjecture remains open after the 2026 counterexample in dimension 3. This paper develops an exact-arithmetic campaign on the lone open degree pair (72,108) below 125, built on Guccione-Guccione-Horruitiner-Valqui (arXiv:2204.14178, Proposition 4.3). Version 0.29 retains the complete weighted three-parameter T_B cover and advances the first higher-dimensional constructible reduction from the 24-parameter cyclic core. With X=A^3 and Y=A^2 C, direction (2,9) gives A^87(R(X,B)+Y S(X,B)), with coprime R and S. Exact divisor norms and a finite maximal-minor atlas close the complete AS nonzero rational graph. Factorwise subresultants then decompose the principal-open base locus into reduced field blocks of degrees 3, 6, 12, and 69, total dimension 90. Exact Bezout identities, independent resultants, multiplication-matrix norms, and direct determinant controls certify a finite atlas uniformly in Y. Thus the complete A nonzero sector of the declared four-parameter restriction is covered. The direct A=0 boundary, 24-parameter core, full 51-parameter family, complete (72,108) case, planar degree floor, and JC(2) remain open.

All scripts, artifacts and verdicts: https://github.com/fsantibanezleal/CAOS_RESEARCH (problems/algebraic-geometry/jacobian-conjecture).
